newsitem.title: INDIA: SBICAP recommends buy on India's ICICI Bank IPO.
newsitem.headline: SBICAP recommends buy on India's ICICI Bank IPO.

text.p: Indian merchant banker SBI Capital Markets (SBICAP) said it recommended a 'buy' on an initial public offering (IPO) of shares by ICICI Banking Corporation.
"ICICI Bank has one of the highest ROAA (return on average assets) among the new private sector banks," SBICAP said a research report on the public issue opening on August 5.
"We project earnings to grow at a compounded annual growth rate of 51 percent over the next two years."
ICICI Bank is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Industrial Credit and Investment Corp of India (ICICI), a leading long-term lending bank, giving access to its large client base.
ICICI is offering 41.25 million shares of 10 rupees face value at 35 rupees each to raise 1.44 billion rupees, constituting 25 percent of the bank's share capital.
"Although the offer PER (price earning ratio) is at the higher end of the spectrum, we believe that the stocks would outperform the market," SBICAP said.

"This is based on our expectation of an annualised EPS of 44 percent over the next two years, the bank's lineage, state-of-the-art technology and the largest branch network among private sector banks," the report said.
ICICI Bank's client base of strong mid-sized corporates with high earning potential makes it a good exposure to this segment, the report said.
SBI Capital Markets is one of the managers to the issue.
